densityPreparation.method: Mass-weighted CIC deposition of simulation stellar particles with authored offline Gaussian smoothing.
densityPreparation.windowOperation: Select source cells x=150..169, y=208..227, z=0..47 and copy their float32 bytes without interpolation or normalization.

alignment.method: Authored central-bar alignment in the XZ simulation projection; rigid -34 degree rotation with no scaling or coordinate warp.
alignment.interpretation: The window is translated into a crop-local frame. This is an authored photograph-to-simulation alignment, not astrometric identity or measured Tarantula depth.

limitations: The source contains simulation stellar density only; it contains no gas or dust particles and does not measure Tarantula emission depth.
The Z cell spacing is 0.20833333333333334 kpc (about 208 pc), far coarser than individual Tarantula structures.
The density field already includes mass-weighted CIC deposition and authored 0.8-voxel Gaussian smoothing; this window step performs no further filtering or normalization.
The XY crop registration and local translation inherit the authored photograph/simulation alignment and are only a weak placement prior.
